/* ==============================================================================
   COMPONENT DESIGN SYSTEM - SECTION 4 SPECIFICATION
   Restrained, precise, quiet academic instrument components.
   ============================================================================== */

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. BUTTONS & ICON BUTTONS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  user-select: none;
  transition: background-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard),
              border-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard),
              color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.btn-md {
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-12);
}

.btn-sm {
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-8);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}

/* Button Variants */
.btn-primary {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  filter: brightness(0.92);
}
.btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) {
  filter: brightness(0.85);
}

.btn-secondary {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border-color: var(--ink-3);
}
.btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) {
  background-color: var(--border);
}

.btn-ghost {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.btn-danger {
  background-color: var(--danger-soft);
  color: var(--danger);
  border-color: var(--danger);
}
.btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background-color: var(--danger);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
}

.btn:disabled, .btn.is-disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.btn-icon {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.btn-icon:hover {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.btn-icon.btn-sm {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. FORM CONTROLS (Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.input, .textarea, .select {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 6px var(--space-12);
  transition: border-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  outline: none;
}

.input {
  height: 34px;
}
.input.input-sm {
  height: 28px;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 4px var(--space-8);
}

.input:focus, .textarea:focus, .select:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}

.input::placeholder, .textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.setup-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-16);
  max-width: 760px;
  padding: var(--space-20);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  background: var(--surface);
}

.setup-form label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-4);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.setup-wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.diagnostic-question {
  margin-top: var(--space-16);
  padding-top: var(--space-16);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.diagnostic-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.history-entry {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface-2);
}

#practice-answer-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: var(--space-12) 0;
}

#practice-prompt {
  margin: var(--space-12) 0;
}

#simulation-result {
  margin-top: var(--space-12);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .setup-form {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .setup-wide {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}

.input:disabled, .textarea:disabled, .select:disabled {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.textarea {
  min-height: 80px;
  resize: vertical;
}

/* Combobox (Searchable Course Selector) */
.combobox-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.combobox-input-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 2px var(--space-8);
  min-height: 34px;
  gap: var(--space-4);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.combobox-input-row:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}

.combobox-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.combobox-tag-remove {
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.combobox-tag-remove:hover {
  color: var(--danger);
}

.combobox-raw-input {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 80px;
}

.combobox-menu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 4px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 200;
  padding: 4px 0;
  display: none;
}

.combobox-item {
  padding: 6px var(--space-12);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.combobox-item:hover, .combobox-item.is-selected {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. TOGGLES, CHECKBOX, RADIO, SLIDER
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.checkbox-row, .radio-row {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.checkbox-custom, .radio-custom {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.radio-custom {
  border-radius: 50%;
}

input[type="checkbox"]:checked + .checkbox-custom {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
input[type="checkbox"]:checked + .checkbox-custom::after {
  content: "";
  width: 4px;
  height: 8px;
  border: solid white;
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

input[type="radio"]:checked + .radio-custom {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
input[type="radio"]:checked + .radio-custom::after {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--accent);
}

.switch {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 36px;
  height: 20px;
}
.switch input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}
.switch-slider {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background-color: var(--border-strong);
  transition: var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  border-radius: 20px;
}
.switch-slider::before {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  height: 14px;
  width: 14px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background-color: white;
  transition: var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.switch input:checked + .switch-slider {
  background-color: var(--accent);
}
.switch input:checked + .switch-slider::before {
  transform: translateX(16px);
}

/* Range Slider */
.slider {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--border-strong);
  outline: none;
}
.slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-slider);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. NAVIGATION: TABS & SEGMENTED CONTROL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.tabs-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.tab-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  padding: var(--space-8) 0;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  margin-bottom: -1px;
}
.tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.tab-btn.is-active {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}

.segmented-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 2px;
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.segmented-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 4px var(--space-12);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.segmented-btn:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.segmented-btn.is-active {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-segmented);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   5. TAGS & BADGES (6px Radius, Sentence Case, Semantic Only)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.tag-neutral {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border-color: var(--border);
  color: var(--ink-2);
}
.tag-success {
  background-color: var(--success-soft);
  border-color: var(--success-border);
  color: var(--success);
}
.tag-warn {
  background-color: var(--warn-soft);
  border-color: var(--warn-border);
  color: var(--warn);
}
.tag-danger {
  background-color: var(--danger-soft);
  border-color: var(--danger-border);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.badge-neutral {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border-color: var(--border);
}
.badge-success {
  background-color: var(--success-soft);
  color: var(--success);
  border-color: var(--success-border);
}
.badge-warn {
  background-color: var(--warn-soft);
  color: var(--warn);
  border-color: var(--warn-border);
}
.badge-danger {
  background-color: var(--danger-soft);
  color: var(--danger);
  border-color: var(--danger-border);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   6. DEFINITION LIST (Label left, Value right, Hairline dividers)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.definition-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.definition-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.definition-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.definition-label {
  color: var(--ink-2);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.definition-value {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: right;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   7. STATS & PROGRESS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.stat-card {
  padding: var(--space-16);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  background-color: var(--surface);
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.stat-value {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 38px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

.stat-delta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-top: var(--space-4);
}
.stat-delta.is-positive { color: var(--success); }
.stat-delta.is-negative { color: var(--danger); }
.stat-delta.is-neutral { color: var(--ink-3); }

.student-status[data-status="on_track"] { color: var(--success); }
.student-status[data-status="needs_attention"] { color: var(--warn); }
.student-status[data-status="behind"] { color: var(--danger); }
.student-status[data-status="insufficient_evidence"] { color: var(--ink-2); }

.student-load-state {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-12);
  max-width: 720px;
  padding: var(--space-24) 0;
}

.loading-skeleton {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface-2);
  animation: loading-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.loading-skeleton-title { width: 40%; height: 34px; }
.loading-skeleton-line { width: 68%; height: 18px; }
.loading-skeleton-panel { width: 100%; height: 150px; margin-top: var(--space-16); }

@keyframes loading-pulse {
  50% { opacity: 0.55; }
}

.student-load-error {
  max-width: 720px;
  padding: var(--space-20) 0;
}

.student-load-error p { margin: 0 0 var(--space-8); }

.admin-seed-warning {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  padding: var(--space-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--danger);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: var(--danger);
  background: var(--surface);
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* Progress Bar */
.progress-bar-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.progress-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background-color: var(--accent);
  transition: width var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.progress-bar-fill.is-success {
  background-color: var(--success);
}

/* Progress Ring (Only where carrying data) */
.progress-ring-wrap {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
}
.progress-ring {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
  transform-origin: 50% 50%;
}
.progress-ring-bg {
  stroke: var(--surface-2);
  fill: none;
}
.progress-ring-fill {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  transition: stroke-dashoffset var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.progress-ring-fill.is-success {
  stroke: var(--success);
}
.progress-ring-label {
  position: absolute;
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   8. TABLES (Sticky Header, Row Hover, Hairline borders)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--surface);
}

.table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}

.table th {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  padding: 8px var(--space-12);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
}

.table td {
  padding: 8px var(--space-12);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.table tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   9. CALLOUTS, EMPTY STATES, SKELETONS, BREADCRUMBS, AVATAR
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.callout {
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-12);
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.callout-info {
  background-color: var(--info-soft);
  border-color: var(--info-border);
  color: var(--info);
}
.callout-warn {
  background-color: var(--warn-soft);
  border-color: var(--warn-border);
  color: var(--warn);
}
.callout-danger {
  background-color: var(--danger-soft);
  border-color: var(--danger-border);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.empty-state {
  padding: var(--space-48) var(--space-24);
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}
.empty-state-icon {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}
.empty-state-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.empty-state-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  max-width: 44ch;
}

.skeleton {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border-radius: 4px;
  animation: skeleton-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes skeleton-pulse {
  0% { opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { opacity: 0.25; }
  100% { opacity: 0.6; }
}

.kbd {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-kbd);
}

.avatar {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}
.breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* Tooltip & Popover */
.tooltip-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}
.tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background-color: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  z-index: 800;
}
.tooltip-wrap:hover .tooltip {
  opacity: 1;
}

.popover {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  right: 0;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  padding: var(--space-12);
  z-index: 800;
  min-width: 220px;
  display: none;
}
.popover.is-active {
  display: block;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   10. TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--space-24);
  right: var(--space-24);
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.toast {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px var(--space-16);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: all var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.toast.toast-success {
  border-color: var(--success-border);
}
.toast.toast-danger {
  border-color: var(--danger-border);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   11. DRAWERS, DIALOGS & COMMAND PALETTE
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.drawer-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background-color: var(--overlay);
  z-index: 500;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.drawer-backdrop.is-active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; right: -420px; bottom: 0;
  width: 420px;
  max-width: 90vw;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  z-index: 501;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: right var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.drawer.is-active {
  right: 0;
}

.dialog {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.97);
  width: 520px;
  max-width: 90vw;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  z-index: 600;
  padding: var(--space-24);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.dialog.is-active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
}

/* Command Palette (Cmd+K) */
.command-palette {
  position: fixed;
  top: 15%; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.98);
  width: 560px;
  max-width: 92vw;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  z-index: 700;
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}
.command-palette.is-active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
}

.command-input-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: var(--space-8);
}
.command-input-row input {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  flex: 1;
}

.command-list {
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--space-8) 0;
}
.command-item {
  padding: 8px var(--space-16);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.command-item:hover, .command-item.is-active {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
}

/* ==============================================================================
   BASE LAYOUT SHELL - SECTION 5 SPECIFICATION
   Left sidebar (240px), 56px Contextual Top Bar, 32px Demo Bar,
   360px Push Buddy Panel, High-Density 12-Column Grid Viewport
   ============================================================================== */

.app-shell {
  display: flex;
  width: 100vw;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg);
}

.tab-pane {
  display: none;
}

.tab-pane.active {
  display: block;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. DEMO BAR (32px strip, visible in demo mode only)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.demo-bar {
  height: 32px;
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 0 var(--space-24);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  z-index: 95;
}

.demo-bar-left, .demo-bar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.demo-persona-select {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink);
  outline: none;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. LEFT SIDEBAR NAVIGATION (240px Default)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-sidebar {
  width: 240px;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  transition: width var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
}

.app-sidebar.is-collapsed {
  width: 64px;
}

.sidebar-header {
  height: 56px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-8);
}

.sidebar-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sidebar-brand-mark {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sidebar-nav {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-8);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  padding: 6px var(--space-8);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.nav-item:hover {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.nav-item.is-active {
  background-color: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.nav-item.is-active .nav-item-icon {
  color: var(--accent);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .nav-item.is-active {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .nav-item.is-active .nav-item-icon {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.nav-item-icon {
  width: 16px;

  flex-shrink: 0;

  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.nav-item-label {
  flex: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.sidebar-footer {
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-8);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. MAIN CONTENT CONTAINER & TOP BAR (56px)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  position: relative;
}

.app-topbar {
  height: 56px;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 0 var(--space-24);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-16);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 90;
}

.topbar-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.topbar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-8);
}

.goal-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
}
.goal-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. CONTENT VIEWPORT (Centered max 1200px)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--space-32);
  max-width: 1200px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   5. RIGHT-HAND BUDDY PANEL (360px Push Layout on Desktop)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.buddy-panel {
  width: 0;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border-left: 1px solid transparent;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100vh;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: width var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard),
              border-color var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
  z-index: 85;
}

.buddy-panel.is-open {
  width: 360px;
  border-left-color: var(--border);
}

.buddy-panel-header {
  height: 56px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.buddy-messages-container {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--space-16);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.buddy-input-row {
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-8);
  background-color: var(--surface);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   6. RESPONSIVENESS (1440, 1024, 768, 390 px)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .app-sidebar {
    width: 64px;
  }
  .app-sidebar .sidebar-brand span:not(.sidebar-brand-mark),
  .app-sidebar .nav-item-label,
  .app-sidebar .sidebar-badge {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .app-shell {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .app-sidebar {
    display: none;
  }
  .app-content {
    padding: var(--space-16);
  }
  .buddy-panel {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 100vw !important;
    transform: translateX(100%);
    transition: transform var(--duration-panel) var(--ease-standard);
    z-index: 999;
  }
  .buddy-panel.is-open {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

/* ==============================================================================
   SCREEN-SPECIFIC STYLES - QUIET ACADEMIC INSTRUMENT

.drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 420px;

  background: var(--surface);

  transform: translateX(102%);
  transition: transform 0.24s ease;
  z-index: 40;
}

.heatmap-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(18px, 1fr));
  gap: 4px;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  gap: var(--space-16);

  background: var(--surface-2, #1E293B);
  padding: 10px 16px;

}

.sem-credit-bar-wrap {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 140px;
  height: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sem-credit-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: #38BDF8;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.plan-course-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-20);
}

.plan-course-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--surface, #0F172A);
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #334155);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px);
  gap: var(--space-12);

}

.plan-course-row:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2, #1E293B);
  border-color: var(--border-strong, #475569);
}

.plan-course-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-12);

  flex: 1;
}

.plan-course-code {

  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;

  color: var(--ink, #F8FAFC);
}

.plan-course-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.plan-course-title-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.plan-course-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink, #F8FAFC);
}

.plan-course-why {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-muted, #94A3B8);
  margin-top: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.plan-course-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.plan-course-credits {
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink, #F8FAFC);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.beyond-coursework-section {
  margin-top: var(--space-20);
  padding-top: var(--space-16);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #334155);
}

.beyond-milestones-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-12);
  margin-top: var(--space-12);
}

.beyond-milestone-card {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-2, #1E293B);
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #334155);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px);
}

.chip-interest {
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  color: #38BDF8;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

.drawer.is-open, .drawer.is-active {
  transform: translateX(0) !important;
  right: 0 !important;
  z-index: 600 !important;
}

.drawer-backdrop.is-open, .drawer-backdrop.is-active {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

.drawer-course-card {
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #334155);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px);
  background: var(--surface, #0F172A);

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.drawer-course-card.is-ineligible {
  opacity: 0.6;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.plan-timeline-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-20);
  margin-top: var(--space-20);
}

.sem-column {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  padding: var(--space-16);

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.sem-head {
  padding-bottom: var(--space-12);

}

.sem-name {

.sem-stats {

}

.course-tile {
  background-color: var(--surface);

              background-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);

}

.course-tile:hover {

}

.course-tile-top {

}

.course-code-txt {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);

  font-size: 13px;

}

.course-credits-txt {

}

.course-title-txt {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);

}

.skill-chips-row {

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}

.skill-chip {

  border: 1px solid var(--border);

  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SCREEN: LEARN & PRACTICE (Split View & Code Editor)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.learn-split-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-24);
  align-items: start;
}

.code-box-container {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);

}

.code-box-header {

  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

textarea.code-editor-input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 260px;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: none;
  padding: var(--space-16);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  resize: vertical;
  outline: none;

}

.code-output-pane {

  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-16);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  max-height: 140px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SCREEN: SKILLS MATRIX (Grouped Matrix View)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.skills-matrix-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-16);
  margin-top: var(--space-16);
}

.skill-matrix-card {

  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);

  gap: var(--space-8);
}

.skill-matrix-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.skill-name-txt {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SCREEN: TODAY (Dashboard Grid & Rows)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.dashboard-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 8fr 4fr;
  gap: var(--space-24);
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .dashboard-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.action-card {
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  padding: var(--space-20);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-20);
}

.action-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
}

.checklist-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.check-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: var(--space-12);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--duration-hover) var(--ease-standard);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.check-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.check-row:hover {
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
}

.check-row.checked {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.check-row.checked .task-text {
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.task-text {
  flex: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.task-meta-time {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CHAT BUBBLE STYLING IN BUDDY PANEL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.chat-stream-box {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-12);
}

.chat-msg {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  max-width: 90%;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}

.chat-msg.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background-color: var(--surface-2);
  padding: 8px var(--space-12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.chat-msg.assistant {
  align-self: flex-start;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 4px 0;
}

.chat-grounding-line {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   ONBOARDING WIZARD (PDF §3 UX, §2.2)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.wizard-header {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto 20px auto;
}

.goal-card, .style-card {
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface-2);
  cursor: pointer;

}

.goal-card:hover, .style-card:hover {

  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.04);
}

.goal-card.is-selected, .style-card.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}

.wizard-chip {
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: all 0.16s ease;
  user-select: none;
}

.wizard-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.wizard-chip.is-selected {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #0F172A;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sem-checklist-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sem-checklist-header {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sem-course-item {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}

.sem-course-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 5: PRACTICE & PROGRESS ENHANCEMENTS (PDF §2.4, §3 UX)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.practice-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-12);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
}

.practice-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--surface-2);
}

.practice-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin-top: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.practice-option.is-correct {
  border-color: #10b981 !important;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12) !important;
  color: #10b981 !important;

}

.practice-option.is-wrong {
  border-color: #ef4444 !important;
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12) !important;
  color: #ef4444 !important;
}

.practice-option.is-correct-target {
  border-color: #10b981 !important;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08) !important;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.study-first-card {
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.study-first-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.evidence-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.readiness-ring-svg {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.readiness-ring-bg {
  stroke: var(--surface-2);
}

.readiness-ring-circle {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.6s ease;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 6: EVALUATOR TOOLS STYLING (PDF §6.1, §7)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.eval-subtab-btn {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.data-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.data-table tr:hover td {

}

.data-table td, .data-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px;
}

/* ==============================================================================
   DESIGN SYSTEM TOKENS - QUIET ACADEMIC INSTRUMENT
   Visual Direction: Calm, Editorial, Trustworthy.
   Zero External Dependencies & 100% Offline Compliant.
   ============================================================================== */

:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --bg: #FAF9F7;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-2: #F3F1ED;
  --border: #E6E2DA;
  --border-strong: #8A8478;
  --ink: #1B1A17;
  --ink-2: #55524B;
  --ink-3: #706C62;
  --accent: #C8341E;
  --accent-soft: #FBEAE6;
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --success: #2E784B;
  --success-soft: #EAF4EE;
  --success-border: #C8E1D1;
  --warn: #99600F;
  --warn-soft: #FBF4E8;
  --warn-border: #E9D5B4;
  --danger: #B42318;
  --danger-soft: #FCEEEC;
  --danger-border: #E7C3BF;
  --info: #2B5C8A;
  --info-soft: #EBF2F8;
  --info-border: #C8D9E8;
  --overlay: rgba(27, 26, 23, 0.35);
  --shadow-slider: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --shadow-segmented: 0 1px 2px rgba(27, 26, 23, 0.05);
  --shadow-kbd: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     TYPOGRAPHY STACKS
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --font-serif: 'Source Serif 4', 'Fraunces', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --font-sans: 'Geist', 'Inter Tight', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     SPACING SCALE (Strict 4px base: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64)
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --space-4: 4px;
  --space-8: 8px;
  --space-12: 12px;
  --space-16: 16px;
  --space-24: 24px;
  --space-32: 32px;
  --space-48: 48px;
  --space-64: 64px;

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     RADIUS SCALE (Strict: 6px controls/tags, 10px panels/dialogs, circles for avatars only)
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --radius-sm: 6px;            /* Controls, tags, buttons, chips */
  --radius-panel: 10px;        /* Panels, cards, dialogs, drawers */
  --radius-full: 999px;        /* Avatars only */

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     ELEVATION (Flatter panels with 1px hairline border. Elevation for popovers/dialogs only)
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --shadow-soft: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     MOTION (Restrained transitions: 120-180ms hover/focus, 220-280ms panels)
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --duration-hover: 140ms;
  --duration-panel: 240ms;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #121110;
  --surface: #1A1917;
  --surface-2: #242220;
  --border: #2E2B28;
  --border-strong: #A8A398;
  --ink: #F2EFE9;
  --ink-2: #BDB8AD;
  --ink-3: #8F8A7F;

  --accent: #E5533B;
  --accent-ink: #121110;
  --accent-soft: #281714;

  --success: #58B97D;
  --success-soft: #1B2E22;
  --success-border: #315940;
  --warn: #DDA143;
  --warn-soft: #332612;
  --warn-border: #684E28;
  --danger: #F0705F;
  --danger-soft: #381714;
  --danger-border: #6A332D;
  --info: #6FA3D6;
  --info-soft: #182A3A;
  --info-border: #34516C;
  --overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --shadow-slider: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-segmented: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  --shadow-kbd: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-soft: 0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

/* ==============================================================================
   GLOBAL CSS RESET & ACCESSIBILITY BASELINE
   ============================================================================== */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 14px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  background-color: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.57;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "cv11" 1;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   TYPOGRAPHIC SCALE (Strictly 7 sizes: 12/16, 13/20, 14/22, 16/24, 20/28, 28/36, 40/44)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.text-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.text-dense {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.text-body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 22px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.text-lead {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 24px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.text-section {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 28px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.text-title {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 36px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.text-metric {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 40px;
  line-height: 44px;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

.text-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

.overline {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Prose constraint (Max 68 characters per line) */
.prose-readable {
  max-width: 68ch;
}

/* Focus Visible Requirement */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Reduced Motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

function toDashboardData(profile, activePlan, summary, skills, exercises) {
    return {
        profile: {
            student_id: profile.student_id,
            name: profile.name,
            programme: profile.programme,
            year: profile.year,
            current_semester: profile.current_semester,
            cgpa: profile.cgpa,
            goal_id: profile.goal_id,
            target_role: profile.target_role ?? null,
            available_hours_per_week: profile.available_hours_per_week,
            remaining_elective_slots: profile.remaining_elective_slots,
        },
        plan: activePlan.plan,
        planDiff: activePlan.diff,
        certificate: activePlan.certificate,
        summary,
        skills,
        exercises: exercises.map(exercise => ({
            exercise_id: exercise.exercise_id,
            title: exercise.title || exercise.prompt,
            prompt: exercise.prompt,
            difficulty: exercise.difficulty,
            type: exercise.type,
            skill_id: exercise.skill_id,
            starter_code: exercise.starter_code,
            options: exercise.options,
        })),
    };
}
class ApiRequestError extends Error {
    requestId;
    status;
    constructor(message, requestId, status) {
        super(message);
        this.requestId = requestId;
        this.status = status;
        this.name = 'ApiRequestError';
    }
}
function formatValidationErrors(detail) {
    if (!Array.isArray(detail))
        return null;
    const issues = detail.flatMap((item) => {
        if (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null || !('msg' in item))
            return [];
        const message = typeof item.msg === 'string' ? item.msg : null;
        if (!message)
            return [];
        const location = 'loc' in item && Array.isArray(item.loc)
            ? item.loc.slice(1).map((part) => String(part)).join('.')
            : '';
        return [location ? `${location}: ${message}` : message];
    });
    return issues.length ? issues.join('; ') : 'The request contains invalid data.';
}
async function request(path, init = {}, externalSignal) {
    const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const onAbort = () => controller.abort();
    externalSignal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(onAbort, 8000);
    try {
        const response = await fetch(path, {
            ...init,
            signal: controller.signal,
            headers: {
                ...(init.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
                ...init.headers,
                'X-Request-ID': requestId,
            },
        });
        const text = await response.text();
        const payload = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
        if (!response.ok) {
            const detail = typeof payload === 'object' && payload !== null && 'detail' in payload
                ? payload.detail
                : null;
            const message = typeof detail === 'string'
                ? detail
                : formatValidationErrors(detail) || `The service returned an error (${response.status}).`;
            throw new ApiRequestError(message, requestId, response.status);
        }
        return payload;
    }
    catch (error) {
        if (externalSignal?.aborted) {
            throw new DOMException('Request cancelled', 'AbortError');
        }
        if (controller.signal.aborted) {
            throw new ApiRequestError('The request timed out after 8 seconds.', requestId);
        }
        if (error instanceof ApiRequestError)
            throw error;
        if (error instanceof SyntaxError) {
            throw new ApiRequestError('The service returned an unreadable response.', requestId);
        }
        throw new ApiRequestError('Could not connect to the learning service.', requestId);
    }
    finally {
        window.clearTimeout(timeout);
        externalSignal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    }
}
function formatStudentSummary(summary) {
    const parts = [
        summary.programme_name,
        `Goal: ${summary.goal_name}`,
        `Year ${summary.year}, Semester ${summary.semester_index}`,
        `CGPA ${summary.cgpa}`,
        `${summary.weekly_hours_available} h/week available`,
    ];
    if (summary.weekly_hours_studied !== null && summary.weekly_hours_studied !== undefined) {
        parts.push(`${summary.weekly_hours_studied} h studied`);
    }
    if (summary.adherence_percentage !== null && summary.adherence_percentage !== undefined) {
        parts.push(`${summary.adherence_percentage}% pace`);
    }
    if (summary.readiness_percentage !== null && summary.readiness_percentage !== undefined) {
        parts.push(`${summary.readiness_percentage}% readiness`);
    }
    if (summary.planned_credits !== null && summary.planned_credits !== undefined && summary.credit_cap) {
        parts.push(`${summary.planned_credits} / ${summary.credit_cap} credits planned`);
    }
    if (summary.status_message) {
        parts.push(summary.status_message);
    }
    return parts.join(' · ');
}

/**
 * Adobe Personalised Learning Buddy - Application Logic & State Engine
 * Built for Quiet Academic Instrument Specification (Linear / Stripe caliber).
 * Zero external telemetry, 100% offline compliant, goal-aware reactive UI.
 */

const state = {
  studentId: '',
  students: [],
  activeTab: 'dashboard',
  profileRecord: null,
  profile: null,
  plan: null,
  planDiff: null,
  certificate: null,
  summary: null,
  skillsMatrix: {},
  exercises: [],
  activeExercise: null,
  llmOfflineMode: false,
  instituteProfile: 'legacy',
  seedConsistency: null,
  requestController: null,
  loadGeneration: 0,
  diagnosticQuestion: null,
  diagnosticAnswered: [],
  simulationScenarios: [],
  buddyLoadedFor: '',
  buddyLoadPromise: null
};

const api = window.LearningBuddyApi;

function runScenario(name) {
  return { scenario: name, status: 'ready' };
}

// Application Lifecycle
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  setupTabs();
  initTheme();
  setupPersonaSelector();
  await loadStudentList();
  if (window.initIcons) window.initIcons();
});

// Theme Management
function initTheme() {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const urlTheme = urlParams.get('theme');
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  const systemTheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  const theme = [urlTheme, savedTheme].find(value => value === 'light' || value === 'dark') || systemTheme;
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  const icon = document.getElementById('theme-icon');
  if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-icon', theme === 'dark' ? 'sun' : 'moon');
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const html = document.documentElement;
  const isDark = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
  const newTheme = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
  html.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme);
  localStorage.setItem('theme', newTheme);
  const icon = document.getElementById('theme-icon');
  if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-icon', isDark ? 'moon' : 'sun');
  if (window.initIcons) window.initIcons();
}

function toggleBuddyPanel() {
  const panel = document.getElementById('buddy-panel') || document.getElementById('buddy-drawer');
  if (panel) {
    panel.classList.toggle('is-open');
    if (panel.classList.contains('is-open')) loadBuddyMemory();
  }
}

async function loadBuddyMemory() {
  if (!state.studentId || state.buddyLoadedFor === state.studentId) return;
  if (state.buddyLoadPromise) {
    await state.buddyLoadPromise;
    if (state.buddyLoadedFor === state.studentId) return;
  }
  const stream = document.getElementById('buddy-chat-stream');
  if (!stream) return;
  const requestedStudent = state.studentId;
  state.buddyLoadPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const memory = await api.getBuddyMemory(requestedStudent);
      if (state.studentId !== memory.student_id) return;
      stream.replaceChildren();
      const history = memory.recent_history || [];
      if (!history.length) {
        const intro = document.createElement('div');
        intro.className = 'chat-msg assistant';
        intro.innerText = 'I can help with your semester plan, electives, prerequisites, or study goals. Ask me anything about your curriculum.';
        stream.appendChild(intro);
      } else {
        history.forEach(turn => {
          const message = document.createElement('div');
          message.className = `chat-msg ${turn.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant'}`;
          message.innerText = turn.content;
          stream.appendChild(message);
        });
      }
      state.buddyLoadedFor = requestedStudent;
    } catch (error) {
      const notice = document.createElement('div');
      notice.className = 'text-meta';
      notice.innerText = `Conversation history is unavailable: ${error.message || 'service error'}`;
      stream.appendChild(notice);
    }
  })();
  try {
    await state.buddyLoadPromise;
  } finally {
    state.buddyLoadPromise = null;
  }
}

// Setup Navigation
function setupTabs() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.app-sidebar .nav-item[data-target]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(btn.dataset.target));
  });
}

function switchTab(target) {
  state.activeTab = target;
  document.querySelectorAll('.app-sidebar .nav-item').forEach(b => {
    b.classList.toggle('is-active', b.dataset.target === target);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(p => {
    p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === `view-${target}`);
  });

  const titles = {
    dashboard: 'Today',
    plan: 'Your plan',
    practice: 'Practise',
    mastery: 'Progress',
    diagnostic: 'Skill check',
    admin: 'Evaluator tools',
    setup: 'Set up profile'
  };
  const topTitle = document.getElementById('topbar-section-title');
  if (topTitle) topTitle.innerText = titles[target] || 'Today';

  if (target === 'plan') renderPlanTimeline();
  if (target === 'mastery') renderMasteryViews();
  if (target === 'practice') renderPracticeSandbox();
  if (target === 'diagnostic') renderDiagnosticView();
  if (target === 'setup') renderOnboardingForm();
  if (target === 'admin') renderEvaluatorTools();
}

function renderDiagnosticView() {
  const status = document.getElementById('diagnostic-status');
  const detail = document.getElementById('diagnostic-status-detail');
  if (!state.summary) return;
  if (status) {
    status.innerText = state.summary.status_message;
    status.dataset.status = state.summary.status;
  }
  if (detail) {
    detail.innerText = state.summary.readiness_percentage === null
      ? `${state.summary.assessed_items_count} of ${state.summary.min_assessed_items} diagnostic items assessed`
      : `Readiness ${state.summary.readiness_percentage}% \u2022 ${state.summary.priority_gap_count} priority gaps`;
  }
  const count = document.getElementById('diagnostic-progress');
  if (count) count.innerText = `${state.diagnosticAnswered.length} answered this session`;
}

const wizardState = {

  totalSteps: 6,

  semester: 3,

const CANONICAL_INTERESTS = [
  "AI/ML", "Systems", "Web and App Dev", "Data and Databases",

];

const SEMESTER_COURSES_CATALOGUE = [
