    return;
  }

  const escapeHtml = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;',
    "'": '&#39;',
  })[character]);

  const state = {
    catalog: null,
    programme: null,
    profile: null,
    selectedCourses: new Set(),
    history: [],
    saving: false,
  };

  function showError(element, error) {
    const requestId = error?.requestId ? ` Request ID: ${error.requestId}` : '';
    element.textContent = `${error?.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'}${requestId}`;
    element.classList.add('is-error');
  }

  function clearStatus(element) {
    element.textContent = '';
    element.classList.remove('is-error');
  }

  function getProgramme(programmeId) {
    return state.catalog.programmes.find(programme => programme.id === programmeId);
  }

  function currentPayload() {
    const form = document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form');
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    return {
      name: String(formData.get('name') || '').trim(),
      programme_id: String(formData.get('programme_id') || ''),
      current_semester: Number(formData.get('current_semester')),
      cgpa: Number(formData.get('cgpa')),
      available_hours_per_week: Number(formData.get('available_hours_per_week')),
      goal: String(formData.get('goal') || '').trim(),
      interests: String(formData.get('interests') || '')
        .split(',')
        .map(value => value.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 12),
      completed_course_codes: String(formData.get('completed_course_codes') || '')
        .split(',')
        .map(value => value.trim().toUpperCase())
        .filter(Boolean),
      shortlisted_course_codes: [...state.selectedCourses],
    };
  }

  function renderProgrammeOptions() {
    const selector = document.getElementById('bhilai-programme');
    const choices = state.catalog.programmes.map(programme => {
      const disabled = programme.status !== 'curriculum_available';
      const label = disabled
        ? `${programme.name} — curriculum not included in source`
        : programme.name;
      return `<option value="${escapeHtml(programme.id)}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>${escapeHtml(label)}</option>`;
    });
    selector.innerHTML = choices.join('');
    state.programme = getProgramme(selector.value);
    renderSemesterOptions();
    renderCoursePicker();
    renderCatalogue();
  }

  function renderSemesterOptions() {
    const selector = document.getElementById('bhilai-semester');
    const semesterCount = state.programme?.semesters.length || 0;
    selector.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: semesterCount }, (_, index) => {
      const semester = index + 1;
      return `<option value="${semester}">Semester ${semester}</option>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function courseCatalogLabel(course) {
    return `${course.credits} cr · ${course.ltp.join('-')}`;
  }

  function renderCatalogue() {
    const query = document.getElementById('bhilai-course-search')?.value.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
    const rows = state.catalog.catalogue_courses
      .filter(course => `${course.code} ${course.title}`.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      .map(course => {
        const checked = state.selectedCourses.has(course.code);
        const status = course.programme_table_status.startsWith(`${state.programme?.degree} `)
          ? course.programme_table_status
          : 'Catalogue listing; elective eligibility not specified';
        return `
          <label class="bhilai-course-option">
            <input type="checkbox" data-course-code="${escapeHtml(course.code)}" ${checked ? 'checked' : ''}>
            <span>
              <strong>${escapeHtml(course.code)} — ${escapeHtml(course.title)}</strong>
              <small>${escapeHtml(courseCatalogLabel(course))} · PDF p. ${course.page}</small>
              <small>${escapeHtml(status)}</small>
            </span>
          </label>`;
      });
    document.getElementById('bhilai-course-list').innerHTML =
      rows.join('') || '<p class="text-meta">No matching catalogue courses.</p>';
  }

  function renderCoursePicker() {
    const picker = document.getElementById('bhilai-course-list');
    if (!picker) return;
    renderCatalogue();
  }

  function curriculumRows(programme, completed) {
    return programme.semesters.map(semester => {
      const courses = semester.courses.map(course => {
        const isCompleted = completed.includes(course.code);
        const type = course.placeholder
          ? 'Unspecified curriculum slot'
          : (course.category ? `${course.category} · listed in curriculum` : 'Category not specified');
        return `
          <li class="${isCompleted ? 'is-completed' : ''}">
            <span><strong>${escapeHtml(course.code)}</strong> — ${escapeHtml(course.title)}</span>
            <span>${course.credits === null ? 'credit value not stated' : `${course.credits} credits`}</span>
            <small>${escapeHtml(type)}${course.note ? ` · ${escapeHtml(course.note)}` : ''}</small>
          </li>`;
      }).join('');
      const current = semester.semester === state.profile.current_semester;
      return `
        <details class="bhilai-semester" ${current ? 'open' : ''}>
          <summary>Semester ${semester.semester}
            <span>${semester.stated_credits} credits${current ? ' · your selected semester' : ''}</span>
          </summary>
          <ul>${courses}</ul>
        </details>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderWorkspace() {
    const programme = getProgramme(state.profile.programme_id);
    state.programme = programme;
    const sourceNotice = state.catalog.source.limitations
      .map(item => `<li>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>`)
      .join('');
    const catalogueCards = state.profile.shortlisted_course_codes.map(code => {
      const course = state.catalog.catalogue_courses.find(item => item.code === code);
      return course
        ? `<li><strong>${escapeHtml(course.code)} — ${escapeHtml(course.title)}</strong> (${course.credits} credits). Catalogue listing only; elective eligibility is unverified.</li>`
        : '';
    }).join('');
    const workspace = document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace');
    workspace.innerHTML = `
      <header class="bhilai-workspace-header">
        <div>
          <p class="overline">Your saved student profile</p>
          <h2>${escapeHtml(state.profile.name)}</h2>
          <p>${escapeHtml(programme.name)} · Semester ${state.profile.current_semester} · CGPA ${state.profile.cgpa}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="bhilai-workspace-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" id="bhilai-edit-profile">Edit profile</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="bhilai-new-profile">Start another</button>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="bhilai-source-warning" role="note">
        This is the official course-of-study reference, not an institute registration or automatically
        validated personalized plan. The supplied document does not establish PE/OE eligibility for
        catalogue-only courses.
      </div>
      <nav class="bhilai-tabs" aria-label="New student sections">
        <button type="button" data-bhilai-tab="curriculum" aria-selected="true">Curriculum</button>
        <button type="button" data-bhilai-tab="catalogue" aria-selected="false">Course catalogue</button>
        <button type="button" data-bhilai-tab="assistant" aria-selected="false">Ask Buddy</button>
      </nav>
      <section data-bhilai-panel="curriculum">
        <p><strong>Minimum:</strong> ${programme.minimum_credits} credits
          ${programme.additional_non_graded_core_units
    ? ` plus ${programme.additional_non_graded_core_units} non-graded core units`
    : ''}.</p>
        <p>Source credit categories: ${Object.entries(programme.credit_categories)
    .map(([category, credits]) => `${escapeHtml(category)} ${credits}`)
    .join(' · ')}.</p>
        <p><strong>Completed courses you reported:</strong>
          ${state.profile.completed_course_codes.map(escapeHtml).join(', ') || 'None entered'}</p>
        <div class="bhilai-semester-list">${curriculumRows(programme, state.profile.completed_course_codes)}</div>
        ${catalogueCards ? `<h3>Courses of interest (not enrollment)</h3><ul>${catalogueCards}</ul>` : ''}
        <details class="bhilai-source-details">
          <summary>Source notes and limitations</summary>
          <ul>${sourceNotice}</ul>
          <p>Source: ${escapeHtml(state.catalog.source.title)}, applicable ${escapeHtml(state.catalog.source.applicable_from)}; curriculum pages ${escapeHtml(state.catalog.source.pages.join(', '))}.</p>
        </details>
      </section>
      <section data-bhilai-panel="catalogue" hidden>
        <label for="bhilai-workspace-search">Search the CSE course descriptions</label>
        <input id="bhilai-workspace-search" class="input" type="search" placeholder="Course code or title">
        <div class="bhilai-catalogue-grid" id="bhilai-workspace-catalogue"></div>
        <p class="text-meta">Catalogue presence alone does not confirm PE/OE eligibility. Shortlisting is for discussion, not enrollment.</p>
      </section>
      <section data-bhilai-panel="assistant" hidden>
        <div class="bhilai-privacy-note">
          Gemini is optional. If you enable it, your programme, semester, reported course codes, goals,
          interests, and chat messages are sent to Google Gemini for that answer. Your name and profile ID
          are not sent. Without consent or a configured key, Buddy answers locally from the supplied source.
        </div>
        <label class="bhilai-consent">
          <input id="bhilai-gemini-consent" type="checkbox">
          I consent to send the listed academic details and my message to Gemini for this reply.
        </label>
        <div class="bhilai-chat" id="bhilai-chat" aria-live="polite">
          <p class="bhilai-chat-message assistant">I can explain the source-listed curriculum and suggest next steps. I will not claim an unspecified catalogue course is PE/OE eligible.</p>
        </div>
        <form id="bhilai-chat-form" class="bhilai-chat-form">
          <label for="bhilai-question">Ask about your next steps or a course code</label>
          <textarea id="bhilai-question" class="input" rows="3" maxlength="2000" required></textarea>
          <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Ask Buddy</button>
          <div id="bhilai-chat-status" class="text-meta" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </form>
      </section>`;

    document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form-wrap').hidden = true;
    workspace.hidden = false;
    document.getElementById('bhilai-edit-profile').addEventListener('click', showProfileForm);
    document.getElementById('bhilai-new-profile').addEventListener('click', startNewProfile);
    workspace.querySelectorAll('[data-bhilai-tab]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => selectWorkspaceTab(button.dataset.bhilaiTab));
    });
    renderWorkspaceCatalogue();
    document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace-search').addEventListener('input', renderWorkspaceCatalogue);
    document.getElementById('bhilai-chat-form').addEventListener('submit', sendAssistantMessage);
  }

  function selectWorkspaceTab(tabName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-bhilai-tab]').forEach(button => {
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(button.dataset.bhilaiTab === tabName));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-bhilai-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      panel.hidden = panel.dataset.bhilaiPanel !== tabName;
    });
  }

  function renderWorkspaceCatalogue() {
    const root = document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace-catalogue');
    const search = document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const rows = state.catalog.catalogue_courses
      .filter(course => `${course.code} ${course.title}`.toLowerCase().includes(search))
      .map(course => `
        <article class="bhilai-catalogue-card">
          <strong>${escapeHtml(course.code)} — ${escapeHtml(course.title)}</strong>
          <span>${course.credits} credits · L-T-P ${course.ltp.join('-')} · PDF p. ${course.page}</span>
          <small>${escapeHtml(course.programme_table_status)}</small>
        </article>`);
    root.innerHTML = rows.join('') || '<p class="text-meta">No matching courses.</p>';
  }

  function showProfileForm() {
    document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace').hidden = true;
    document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form-wrap').hidden = false;
    const form = document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form');
    if (state.profile) {
      form.elements.name.value = state.profile.name;
      form.elements.programme_id.value = state.profile.programme_id;
      state.programme = getProgramme(state.profile.programme_id);
      renderSemesterOptions();
      form.elements.current_semester.value = String(state.profile.current_semester);
      form.elements.cgpa.value = String(state.profile.cgpa);
      form.elements.available_hours_per_week.value = String(state.profile.available_hours_per_week);
      form.elements.goal.value = state.profile.goal;
      form.elements.interests.value = state.profile.interests.join(', ');
      form.elements.completed_course_codes.value = state.profile.completed_course_codes.join(', ');
      state.selectedCourses = new Set(state.profile.shortlisted_course_codes);
      renderCoursePicker();
    }
  }

  function startNewProfile() {
    state.profile = null;
    state.history = [];
    state.selectedCourses.clear();
    localStorage.removeItem('bhilaiOnboardingProfileId');
    const form = document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form');
    form.reset();
    form.elements.programme_id.value = 'iit_bhilai_btech_cse_2023';
    state.programme = getProgramme(form.elements.programme_id.value);
    renderSemesterOptions();
    renderCoursePicker();
    document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace').hidden = true;
    document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form-wrap').hidden = false;
    clearStatus(document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-status'));
  }

  async function saveProfile(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (state.saving) return;
    state.saving = true;
    const status = document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-status');
    clearStatus(status);
    status.textContent = 'Saving your profile…';
    try {
      const payload = currentPayload();
      state.profile = state.profile
        ? await api.updateOnboardingProfile(state.profile.student_id, payload)
        : await api.createOnboardingProfile(payload);
      localStorage.setItem('bhilaiOnboardingProfileId', state.profile.student_id);
      state.history = [];
      renderWorkspace();
    } catch (error) {
      showError(status, error);
    } finally {
      state.saving = false;
      if (!status.classList.contains('is-error')) status.textContent = '';
    }
  }

  function addChatMessage(role, text, mode) {
    const stream = document.getElementById('bhilai-chat');
    const message = document.createElement('p');
    message.className = `bhilai-chat-message ${role}`;
    message.textContent = text;
    stream.appendChild(message);
    if (mode) {
      const label = document.createElement('small');
      label.className = 'bhilai-chat-mode';
      label.textContent = mode === 'gemini'
        ? 'Gemini response'
        : mode === 'offline'
          ? 'Local fallback (Gemini unavailable)'
          : 'Private local response';
      stream.appendChild(label);
    }
    stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
  }

  async function sendAssistantMessage(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const questionField = document.getElementById('bhilai-question');
    const status = document.getElementById('bhilai-chat-status');
    const question = questionField.value.trim();
    if (!question || !state.profile) return;
    clearStatus(status);
    status.textContent = 'Buddy is preparing a source-grounded answer…';
    const share = document.getElementById('bhilai-gemini-consent').checked;
    const priorHistory = state.history.slice(-8);
    addChatMessage('user', question);
    questionField.value = '';
    try {
      const result = await api.sendOnboardingMessage({
        profile_id: state.profile.student_id,
        question,
        share_with_gemini: share,
        history: priorHistory,
      });
      addChatMessage('assistant', `${result.reply}\n\n${result.privacy_note}`, result.mode);
      state.history = [
        ...priorHistory,
        { role: 'user', content: question },
        { role: 'assistant', content: result.reply },
      ].slice(-8);
    } catch (error) {
      showError(status, error);
      questionField.value = question;
    } finally {
      if (!status.classList.contains('is-error')) status.textContent = '';
    }
  }

  function buildDialog() {
    const stylesheet = document.createElement('link');
    stylesheet.rel = 'stylesheet';
    stylesheet.href = '/static/css/new-student.css';
    document.head.appendChild(stylesheet);

    const dialog = document.createElement('dialog');
    dialog.id = 'bhilai-onboarding-dialog';
    dialog.className = 'bhilai-onboarding-dialog';
    dialog.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'bhilai-onboarding-title');
    dialog.innerHTML = `
      <header class="bhilai-dialog-header">
        <div>
          <p class="overline">IIT Bhilai · Computer Science and Engineering</p>
          <h1 id="bhilai-onboarding-title">Start with your own student profile</h1>
          <p class="text-meta">The profile and curriculum data are saved locally in this app's database.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="bhilai-close-dialog" aria-label="Close onboarding">Close</button>
      </header>
      <div id="bhilai-profile-form-wrap">
        <form id="bhilai-profile-form" class="bhilai-profile-form">
          <label>Full name
            <input class="input" name="name" autocomplete="name" maxlength="120" required>
          </label>
          <label>Programme
            <select class="input" name="programme_id" id="bhilai-programme" required></select>
          </label>
          <label>Current semester
            <select class="input" name="current_semester" id="bhilai-semester" required></select>
          </label>
          <label>Current CGPA (0–10)
            <input class="input" type="number" name="cgpa" min="0" max="10" step="0.01" value="0" required>
          </label>
          <label>Study hours available each week
            <input class="input" type="number" name="available_hours_per_week" min="0" max="80" step="0.5" value="10" required>
          </label>
          <label>Goal
            <input class="input" name="goal" maxlength="160" placeholder="e.g. systems research, software engineering" required>
          </label>
          <label class="bhilai-wide">Interests (comma-separated)
            <input class="input" name="interests" maxlength="500" placeholder="AI, algorithms, systems">
          </label>
          <label class="bhilai-wide">Completed course codes (comma-separated)
            <input class="input" name="completed_course_codes" maxlength="800" placeholder="CSL100, CSL201">
            <small>Enter only courses you report as completed. Codes are checked against this programme's named sequence.</small>
          </label>
          <fieldset class="bhilai-wide">
            <legend>Shortlist courses to discuss with Buddy</legend>
            <p class="text-meta">Shortlisting records interest only. Catalogue listing does not confirm PE/OE eligibility or enrollment.</p>
            <input class="input" id="bhilai-course-search" type="search" placeholder="Search course code or title">
            <div class="bhilai-course-list" id="bhilai-course-list"></div>
          </fieldset>
          <button class="btn btn-primary bhilai-wide" id="bhilai-save-profile" type="submit">Create profile and view curriculum</button>
          <div id="bhilai-profile-status" class="text-meta bhilai-wide" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </form>
        <p class="bhilai-source-warning" id="bhilai-programme-note"></p>
      </div>
      <section id="bhilai-workspace" hidden></section>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(dialog);

    const selector = document.getElementById('persona-select');
    if (!selector) {
      throw new Error('Student selector is missing; new-student onboarding cannot be opened.');
    }
    const openButton = document.createElement('button');
    openButton.type = 'button';
    openButton.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-sm bhilai-open-button';
    openButton.textContent = 'New IIT Bhilai student';
    openButton.addEventListener('click', () => openDialog());
    selector.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', openButton);

    document.getElementById('bhilai-close-dialog').addEventListener('click', () => dialog.close());
    dialog.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target === dialog) dialog.close();
    });
    document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form').addEventListener('submit', saveProfile);
    document.getElementById('bhilai-programme').addEventListener('change', event => {
      state.programme = getProgramme(event.target.value);
      renderSemesterOptions();
      renderCoursePicker();
      document.getElementById('bhilai-programme-note').textContent =
        state.programme.degree === 'BTech'
          ? 'BTech requirements: 144 credits plus 12 non-graded core units. The source does not name PE/OE course choices.'
          : 'MTech requirements: 54 credits, including thesis. Elective choices are placeholders in the supplied source.';
    });
    document.getElementById('bhilai-course-search').addEventListener('input', renderCoursePicker);
    document.getElementById('bhilai-course-list').addEventListener('change', event => {
      const code = event.target.dataset.courseCode;
      if (!code) return;
      if (event.target.checked) state.selectedCourses.add(code);
      else state.selectedCourses.delete(code);
    });
    return dialog;
  }

  async function openDialog() {
    const dialog = document.getElementById('bhilai-onboarding-dialog');
    dialog.showModal();
    const status = document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-status');
    clearStatus(status);
    status.textContent = 'Loading verified programme and catalogue data…';
    try {
      state.catalog = await api.getProgrammes();
      renderProgrammeOptions();
      const profileId = localStorage.getItem('bhilaiOnboardingProfileId');
      if (profileId) {
        try {
          state.profile = await api.getOnboardingProfile(profileId);
          state.history = [];
          renderWorkspace();
          return;
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.status !== 404) throw error;
          localStorage.removeItem('bhilaiOnboardingProfileId');
        }
      }
      state.profile = null;
      document.getElementById('bhilai-profile-form-wrap').hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('bhilai-workspace').hidden = true;
      status.textContent = '';
      document.getElementById('bhilai-programme-note').textContent =
        'The supplied course-of-study document contains detailed CSE curricula for BTech and MTech. PhD is listed as a degree offering, but its curriculum is not included.';
    } catch (error) {
      showError(status, error);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    buildDialog();
  });
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <style>
    .styleguide-viewport {
      max-width: 1080px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--space-48) var(--space-32);
    }
    .guide-section {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-48);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-32);
    }
    .guide-grid-2 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-24);
    }
    .guide-grid-3 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-20);
    }
    .guide-grid-4 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-16);
    }
    .swatch {
      height: 64px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: var(--space-8);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }
    .swatch-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-12);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: var(--space-12);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="app-shell">
    <main class="app-main">
      <!-- Top Bar with Theme Toggle -->
      <div class="app-topbar">
        <div class="topbar-left">
          <div class="breadcrumb">
            <a href="/">Learning Buddy</a>
            <span>/</span>
            <span style="color:var(--ink); font-weight:500;">Design System Styleguide</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="topbar-right">
          <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" id="theme-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleTheme()">
            <span data-icon="moon" data-icon-size="14" id="theme-icon"></span>
            <span id="theme-text">Dark mode</span>
          </button>
          <a href="/" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">
            <span data-icon="arrow-left" data-icon-size="14"></span>
            Back to app
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="styleguide-viewport">
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="view-header">
          <div class="overline">Foundations & Component Catalog</div>

  <script>
    function toggleTheme() {
      const html = document.documentElement;
      const isDark = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      const newTheme = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', newTheme);
      document.getElementById('theme-text').innerText = isDark ? 'Dark mode' : 'Light mode';
      document.getElementById('theme-icon').setAttribute('data-icon', isDark ? 'moon' : 'sun');
      if (window.initIcons) window.initIcons();
    }

    // Initialize saved theme or system preference
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const urlTheme = urlParams.get('theme');
      const savedTheme = urlTheme || localStorage.getItem('theme');
      if (savedTheme) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', savedTheme);
        if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
          document.getElementById('theme-text').innerText = 'Light mode';
          document.getElementById('theme-icon').setAttribute('data-icon', 'sun');
        }
      } else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
        document.getElementById('theme-text').innerText = 'Light mode';
        document.getElementById('theme-icon').setAttribute('data-icon', 'sun');
      }
      if (window.initIcons) window.initIcons();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

"""
Unit Tests for Phase 5: Adaptation Policy & Simulation Engine.
Verifies policy rules, strong vs. weak quiz adaptation, plan diffing,
student course override trade-offs, behavioural drift, and fast-forward scenarios.
"""

import unittest
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.adapt.policy import adaptation_policy_engine
from backend.adapt.simulator import adaptation_simulator, SCRIPTED_SCENARIOS
from backend.api.adapt import (
    list_simulation_scenarios,
    simulate_scenario,
    submit_course_override,
    evaluate_adaptation_signals,
    get_adaptation_audit_log,
    SimulateScenarioRequest,
    CourseOverrideRequest,
    SignalEvaluationRequest
)

class TestAdaptationEngine(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        """Reset and seed database state for clean test baseline."""
        load_seed_data()

    def test_01_adaptation_policy_loading(self):
        """Verify adaptation policy correctly parses configured YAML rules."""
        self.assertIsNotNone(adaptation_policy_engine.policy)
        rules = adaptation_policy_engine.policy.get("rules", [])
        rule_ids = [r["id"] for r in rules]
        self.assertIn("RULE_ACCELERATE", rule_ids)
        self.assertIn("RULE_REMEDIATE", rule_ids)
        self.assertIn("RULE_SPACED_REVIEW", rule_ids)
        self.assertIn("RULE_BEHAVIOURAL_DRIFT", rule_ids)
        self.assertIn("RULE_STUDENT_OVERRIDE", rule_ids)

    def test_02_policy_signal_evaluations(self):
        """Test policy engine triggers correct actions based on score, bkt, drift, and override."""
        # Strong score
        actions = adaptation_policy_engine.evaluate_signals("BH-SW-001", {"score": 0.95, "bkt_probability": 0.90})
        self.assertTrue(any(a.action_type == "ACCELERATE" for a in actions))

        # Weak score
        actions = adaptation_policy_engine.evaluate_signals("BH-SW-001", {"score": 0.20, "bkt_probability": 0.25})
        self.assertTrue(any(a.action_type == "REMEDIATE" for a in actions))

        # Repeated misses
        actions = adaptation_policy_engine.evaluate_signals("BH-SW-001", {"consecutive_misses": 4})
        self.assertTrue(any(a.action_type == "REVIEW_SPACED" for a in actions))

        # Behavioural drift
        actions = adaptation_policy_engine.evaluate_signals("BH-SW-001", {"actual_weekly_hours": 3.0, "target_weekly_hours": 8.0})
        self.assertTrue(any(a.action_type == "LOAD_SHED" for a in actions))

        # Student override
        actions = adaptation_policy_engine.evaluate_signals("BH-SW-001", {"student_override": {"rejected_course": "CSL303"}})
        self.assertTrue(any(a.action_type == "OVERRIDE_RESOLVE" for a in actions))

    def test_03_strong_quiz_adaptation(self):
        """Verify strong quiz triggers acceleration and produces an independently valid plan."""
        res = adaptation_simulator.run_strong_quiz("BH-SW-001")
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "adapted")
        self.assertEqual(res["action_triggered"], "ACCELERATE")
        self.assertTrue(res["bkt_update"]["mastered"])
        self.assertTrue(res["validation"]["is_valid"])
        self.assertTrue(any(k in res["plan_diff"] for k in ["added_courses", "removed_courses", "rescheduled_courses"]))
        self.assertTrue(len(res["explanation"]) > 20)

    def test_04_weak_quiz_adaptation(self):
        """Verify weak quiz triggers remediation, inserts practice resources, and produces valid plan."""
        res = adaptation_simulator.run_weak_quiz("BH-SW-001")
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "adapted")
        self.assertEqual(res["action_triggered"], "REMEDIATE")
        self.assertFalse(res["bkt_update"]["mastered"])
        self.assertTrue(res["validation"]["is_valid"])
        self.assertEqual(res["remedial_resources_added"], 2)
        # Verify remedial resources exist in the adapted plan's first semester
        first_sem = res["adapted_plan"]["semesters"][0]
        self.assertIn("remedial_resources", first_sem)
        self.assertEqual(len(first_sem["remedial_resources"]), 2)

    def test_05_course_override_and_tradeoffs(self):
        """Verify student course rejection excludes the course and calculates trade-offs."""
        res = adaptation_simulator.run_course_override("BH-SW-001", rejected_course="CSL303")
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "adapted")
        self.assertEqual(res["action_triggered"], "OVERRIDE_RESOLVE")
        self.assertTrue(res["validation"]["is_valid"])

        # Verify CSL303 is absent from all scheduled semesters
        scheduled_codes = [c["code"] for s in res["adapted_plan"]["semesters"] for c in s["courses"]]
        self.assertNotIn("CSL303", scheduled_codes)

        # Check trade-off calculation
        tradeoffs = res["tradeoffs"]
        self.assertEqual(tradeoffs["rejected_course"], "CSL303")
        self.assertIn("CSL303", tradeoffs["removed_courses"])
        self.assertIn("database_systems", tradeoffs["skills_lost"])

    def test_06_behavioural_drift_loadshedding(self):
        """Verify low study hours triggers workload reduction with a valid schedule."""
        res = adaptation_simulator.run_behavioural_drift("BH-SW-001", logged_weekly_hours=3.0)
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "adapted")
        self.assertEqual(res["action_triggered"], "LOAD_SHED")
        self.assertTrue(res["validation"]["is_valid"])
        self.assertIn("engagement", res["explanation"].lower())

    def test_07_fast_forward_scenario(self):
        """Verify fast-forward advances student semester, records completed course, and re-plans."""
        res = adaptation_simulator.run_fast_forward("BH-SW-001")
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "fast_forwarded")
        self.assertEqual(res["new_semester"], 4)
        self.assertTrue(res["validation"]["is_valid"])
        self.assertIn("Fast-forwarded to Semester 5", res["explanation"])

    def test_08_api_endpoints_and_audit_history(self):
        """Verify REST endpoints for scenarios, simulation, overrides, signal evaluation, and audit log."""
        # 1. Scenarios catalog
        scenarios_res = list_simulation_scenarios()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(scenarios_res["count"], 5)

        # 2. Simulate endpoint
        sim_res = simulate_scenario(SimulateScenarioRequest(scenario_id="scenario_strong_quiz", student_id="BH-SW-001"))
        self.assertEqual(sim_res["status"], "adapted")

        # 3. Override endpoint
        ovr_res = submit_course_override(CourseOverrideRequest(student_id="BH-SW-001", rejected_course="CSL303"))
        self.assertEqual(ovr_res["status"], "adapted")

        # 4. Signal evaluation endpoint
        eval_res = evaluate_adaptation_signals(SignalEvaluationRequest(
            student_id="BH-SW-001",
            signals={"score": 0.95, "bkt_probability": 0.90}
        ))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(eval_res["actions_triggered_count"], 1)

        # 5. Audit log endpoint
        audit_res = get_adaptation_audit_log("BH-SW-001")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(audit_res["total_events"], 1)
        first_event = audit_res["events"][0]
        self.assertIn("action_type", first_event)
        self.assertIn("explanation", first_event)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Source and onboarding checks for the IIT Bhilai CSE student flow."""

import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.db import database
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.main import app


class TestBhilaiOnboarding(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        cls.original_db_path = database.DB_PATH
        database.DB_PATH = Path(cls.temp_dir.name) / "onboarding-test.db"
        load_seed_data(reset=True)
        cls.client = TestClient(app)
        cls.client.__enter__()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.client.__exit__(None, None, None)
        database.DB_PATH = cls.original_db_path
        cls.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def _profile_payload(self, **overrides):
        payload = {
            "name": "New Bhilai Student",
            "programme_id": "iit_bhilai_btech_cse_2023",
            "current_semester": 3,
            "cgpa": 8.2,
            "available_hours_per_week": 12,
            "goal": "Explore AI and systems",
            "interests": ["AI", "systems"],
            "completed_course_codes": ["CSL100", "MAL100"],
            "shortlisted_course_codes": ["CSL304", "CSL622"],
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def test_programme_data_matches_source_credit_totals_and_catalogue(self):
        response = self.client.get("/api/curricula")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
        data = response.json()
        programmes = {item["degree"]: item for item in data["programmes"]}
        btech = programmes["BTech"]
        mtech = programmes["MTech"]
        phd = programmes["PhD"]

        self.assertEqual(sum(row["stated_credits"] for row in btech["semesters"]), 144)
        self.assertEqual(sum(btech["credit_categories"].values()), 144)
        self.assertEqual(btech["additional_non_graded_core_units"], 12)
        self.assertEqual(sum(row["stated_credits"] for row in mtech["semesters"]), 54)
        self.assertEqual(sum(mtech["credit_categories"].values()), 54)
        self.assertEqual(phd["status"], "programme_listed_curriculum_unavailable")
        self.assertEqual(len(data["catalogue_courses"]), 44)
        self.assertIn("eligibility not specified", data["catalogue_courses"][-1]["programme_table_status"])

    def test_new_profile_is_saved_and_reloadable_without_becoming_a_seeded_persona(self):
        created = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(),
        )
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        profile = created.json()
        self.assertTrue(profile["student_id"].startswith("BH-"))
        self.assertEqual(profile["completed_course_codes"], ["CSL100", "MAL100"])
        self.assertEqual(profile["shortlisted_course_codes"], ["CSL304", "CSL622"])

        loaded = self.client.get(f"/api/onboarding/profiles/{profile['student_id']}")
        self.assertEqual(loaded.status_code, 200, loaded.text)
        self.assertEqual(loaded.json(), profile)
        demo_persona_ids = {
            item["student_id"] for item in self.client.get("/api/students").json()
            if item.get("is_demo")
        }
        self.assertNotIn(profile["student_id"], demo_persona_ids)
        all_student_ids = {
            item["student_id"] for item in self.client.get("/api/students").json()
        }
        self.assertIn(profile["student_id"], all_student_ids)

    def test_update_changes_saved_profile_and_revalidates_course_choices(self):
        created = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(),
        )
        profile_id = created.json()["student_id"]
        payload = self._profile_payload(
            cgpa=8.5,
            current_semester=4,
            completed_course_codes=["CSL100", "MAL100", "CSL201"],
        )
        updated = self.client.put(
            f"/api/onboarding/profiles/{profile_id}",
            json=payload,
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertEqual(updated.json()["cgpa"], 8.5)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get(f"/api/onboarding/profiles/{profile_id}").json()["current_semester"],
            4,
        )

    def test_unknown_programme_and_course_combinations_are_rejected(self):
        unsupported = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(programme_id="iit_bhilai_phd_cse"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(unsupported.status_code, 422)

        unknown_course = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(completed_course_codes=["NOT_A_COURSE"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(unknown_course.status_code, 422)

        duplicate_course = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(completed_course_codes=["CSL100", "CSL100"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(duplicate_course.status_code, 422)
        self.assertIn("only be entered once", duplicate_course.json()["detail"])

        unavailable_semester = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(current_semester=9),
        )
        self.assertEqual(unavailable_semester.status_code, 422)

    def test_assistant_local_mode_uses_source_curriculum_without_calling_gemini(self):
        profile = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(current_semester=1, completed_course_codes=[]),
        ).json()
        with patch("backend.api.onboarding.llm_client.generate") as generate:
            response = self.client.post(
                "/api/onboarding/assistant",
                json={
                    "profile_id": profile["student_id"],
                    "question": "What should I do next?",
                    "share_with_gemini": False,
                },
            )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["mode"], "local")
        self.assertIn("CSL100", response.json()["reply"])
        self.assertIn("not sent to Gemini", response.json()["privacy_note"])
        generate.assert_not_called()

    def test_gemini_assistant_context_omits_profile_name_and_id(self):
        profile = self.client.post(
            "/api/onboarding/profiles",
            json=self._profile_payload(),
        ).json()
        with patch(
            "backend.api.onboarding.llm_client.generate",
            return_value={"content": "Review your current semester courses.", "fallback_used": False},
        ) as generate:
            response = self.client.post(
                "/api/onboarding/assistant",
                json={
                    "profile_id": profile["student_id"],
                    "question": "What are my next steps?",
                    "share_with_gemini": True,
                },
            )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["mode"], "gemini")
        messages = generate.call_args.kwargs["messages"]
        prompt = "\n".join(message["content"] for message in messages)
        self.assertNotIn(profile["name"], prompt)
        self.assertNotIn(profile["student_id"], prompt)
        self.assertIn("CSL100", prompt)
        self.assertIn("does not establish PE/OE eligibility", prompt)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.db import database
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.main import app

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SEED_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "seed_bhilai"
SOURCE_FILE = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "seed_bhilai" / "iit_bhilai_cse_curricula.json"


class TestBhilaiSeed(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):

        cls.original_db_path = database.DB_PATH
        database.DB_PATH = Path(cls.temp_dir.name) / "bhilai-test.db"
        load_seed_data(reset=True)
        cls.client_context = TestClient(app)
        cls.client = cls.client_context.__enter__()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.client_context.__exit__(None, None, None)
        database.DB_PATH = cls.original_db_path
        cls.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_seed_courses_match_source_catalogue_and_semester_slots(self):
        seeded = json.loads((SEED_DIR / "courses.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(seeded), 30)
        for course in seeded:
            with self.subTest(course=course["code"]):
                self.assertTrue(course["code"])
                self.assertTrue(course["title"])
                self.assertGreater(course["credits"], 0)
                self.assertIn("IIT Bhilai Courses of Study", course["source"])
                self.assertIsNotNone(course.get("source_page"))

    def test_every_seeded_student_has_a_summary_and_planner_is_restored(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/health").json()["institute_profile"], "iit_bhilai")
        students_response = self.client.get("/api/students")
        self.assertEqual(students_response.status_code, 200, students_response.text)
        students = students_response.json()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(students), 3)

        for student in students[:10]:
            with self.subTest(student_id=student["student_id"]):
                response = self.client.get(
                    f"/api/students/{student['student_id']}/summary"
                )
                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)

        rules = self.client.get("/api/rules").json()
        self.assertGreater(len(rules), 0)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.post(
                "/api/plans/generate",
                json={"student_id": students[0]["student_id"]},
            ).status_code,
            200,
        )
        diagnostic = self.client.get(
            f"/api/students/{students[0]['student_id']}/diagnostic/next"
        )
        self.assertEqual(diagnostic.status_code, 200, diagnostic.text)
        self.assertTrue(diagnostic.json()["available"])

    def test_buddy_answers_course_lookup_from_the_seed_without_live_ai(self):
        student = self.client.get("/api/students").json()[0]

        def deterministic_fallback(**kwargs):
            return {
                "content": kwargs["fallback_data"]["deterministic_reply"],
                "fallback_used": True,
            }

        with patch(
            "backend.buddy.router.llm_client.generate",
            side_effect=deterministic_fallback,
        ) as generate:
            response = self.client.post(
                "/api/buddy/chat",
                json={
                    "student_id": student["student_id"],
                    "message": "Why was CSL100 listed?",
                },
            )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
        self.assertIn("Introduction to Programming", response.json()["reply"])
        generate.assert_called_once()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""
Unit Tests for Phase 6: Conversational Buddy & Safety Engine.
Verifies intent routing, multi-turn memory retention, persistent storage,
prompt injection defense, and course code hallucination interception.
"""

import unittest
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.buddy.router import buddy_router
from backend.buddy.safety import buddy_safety
from backend.buddy.memory import buddy_memory
from backend.api.buddy import (
    send_chat_message,
    get_student_memory,
    clear_student_memory,
    ChatRequest
)

class TestConversationalBuddy(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        """Clean seed database."""
        load_seed_data()
        buddy_memory.clear_history("BH-SW-001")

    def test_01_intent_classification(self):
        """Verify intent router accurately maps key student questions."""
        self.assertEqual(buddy_router.classify_intent("What do I know?"), "WHAT_I_KNOW")
        self.assertEqual(buddy_router.classify_intent("Where am I lagging?"), "SKILL_GAPS")
        self.assertEqual(buddy_router.classify_intent("Why was CSL202 recommended?"), "EXPLAIN_COURSE")

"""
Tests for Courses of Study Document Retrieval, Chunking, Citations & Embeddings (§2.1, §2.5, §5).
Asserts that:
1. Courses of Study text is chunked with source page numbers.
2. BM25 and Hybrid retrieval locate correct course syllabus and rule chunks.
3. Buddy answers about course content, credits, or rules cite official page numbers (PDF p. X).
4. EMBEDDING_MODEL is wired into retrieval and executes via LiteLLMClient.embed().
"""

import pytest
from backend.retrieval.indexer import retriever
from backend.buddy.router import buddy_router
from backend.llm.client import llm_client
from backend.config import settings
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def setup_retrieval_tests():
    load_seed_data(reset=True)
    llm_client.offline = True
    retriever.initialize()


def test_chunking_and_page_provenance():
    assert len(retriever.chunks) >= 100, f"Expected at least 100 chunks, got {len(retriever.chunks)}"
    pages = set(c["source_page"] for c in retriever.chunks)
    assert len(pages) >= 50, "Chunks must span across multiple pages of Courses of Study"

    # Verify CSL100 chunk has exact page 83 citation
    csl100 = retriever.lookup_course("CSL100")
    assert csl100 is not None, "CSL100 must be indexed"
    assert csl100["source_page"] == 83, f"Expected page 83 for CSL100, got {csl100['source_page']}"
    assert "PDF p. 83" in csl100["source_citation"]
    assert "Introduction to Programming" in csl100["text"]


def test_bm25_search_citations():
    results = retriever.search_bm25("Introduction to Programming CSL100", top_k=3)
    assert len(results) > 0, "BM25 search should return results"
    top = results[0]
    assert "source_page" in top
    assert "source_citation" in top
    assert "PDF p." in top["source_citation"]


def test_buddy_course_content_answer_cites_page():
    # 1. Asking why a course is in plan / explain course
    ans1 = buddy_router.handle_message("BH-SW-001", "Why CSL201 in my plan?")
    reply1 = ans1.get("reply", "")
    assert "PDF p." in reply1 or "Courses of Study" in reply1, (
        f"Buddy reply must cite source document and page number. Got: {reply1}"
    )

    # 2. General course syllabus question
    ans2 = buddy_router.handle_message("BH-SW-001", "What topics are taught in CSL100 Introduction to Programming?")
    reply2 = ans2.get("reply", "")
    assert "PDF p." in reply2 or "Courses of Study" in reply2, (
        f"Buddy reply must cite source document and page number. Got: {reply2}"
    )


def test_embedding_model_wiring_and_hybrid_retrieval():
    # Test dense embedding generation
    test_texts = [
        "Data structures and algorithms complexity",
        "Operating systems processes and memory management"
    ]
    vectors = llm_client.embed(test_texts)
    assert len(vectors) == 2
    assert len(vectors[0]) > 0
    assert all(isinstance(val, float) for val in vectors[0])

    # Test semantic vector search execution
    sem_results = retriever.search_semantic("Data Structures and Algorithms", top_k=3)
    assert len(sem_results) > 0
    assert "source_page" in sem_results[0]
    assert "semantic_score" in sem_results[0]

"""
Unit tests for PostgreSQL / SQLite Database Adapter, Seeds Auto-Load, Adminer Students View,
and Admin Grade Recomputation.
"""

import unittest
from backend.db.database import (
    adapt_sql_for_postgres,
    get_db_cursor,
    init_db,
    is_postgres
)
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data, reset_database
from backend.student.model import StudentStore, StudentProfile, CompletedCourse
from backend.api.admin import edit_student_grade, EditGradeRequest
from backend.config import settings

class TestDatabaseAndAdminGradeFlow(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        load_seed_data(reset=True)

    def test_sql_adaptation_for_postgres(self):
        """Verifies that SQLite DDL and DML statements are cleanly adapted to valid PostgreSQL syntax."""
        # 1. Parameter placeholder translation
        q_params = "SELECT * FROM courses WHERE code = ? AND credits = ?;"
        adapted_params = adapt_sql_for_postgres(q_params)
        self.assertIn("%s", adapted_params)
        self.assertNotIn("?", adapted_params)

        # 2. DROP TABLE with CASCADE
        q_drop = "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS student_profiles;"
        adapted_drop = adapt_sql_for_postgres(q_drop)
        self.assertEqual(adapted_drop, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS student_profiles CASCADE;")

        # 3. INSERT OR REPLACE ON CONFLICT translation
        q_insert = """
        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO student_profiles (
            student_id, name, programme, year, current_semester, cgpa,
            goal_id, target_role, available_hours_per_week, remaining_elective_slots,
            completed_courses_json, constraints_json, preferences_json, updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
        """
        adapted_insert = adapt_sql_for_postgres(q_insert)
        self.assertIn("INSERT INTO student_profiles", adapted_insert)
        self.assertIn("ON CONFLICT (student_id) DO UPDATE SET", adapted_insert)
        self.assertIn("name = EXCLUDED.name", adapted_insert)
        self.assertIn("cgpa = EXCLUDED.cgpa", adapted_insert)
        self.assertNotIn("?", adapted_insert)

        # 4. Prerequisites conflict on composite keys
        q_prereq = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO prerequisites (course_code, requires_code, type, source) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?);"
        adapted_prereq = adapt_sql_for_postgres(q_prereq)
        self.assertIn("ON CONFLICT (course_code, requires_code) DO UPDATE SET", adapted_prereq)

        # 5. Autoincrement to SERIAL
        q_serial = "CREATE TABLE test (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT);"
        adapted_serial = adapt_sql_for_postgres(q_serial)
        self.assertIn("id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY", adapted_serial)

    def test_adminer_students_view(self):
        """
        Verifies that the database presents a 'students' view containing all seeded student records,
        allowing database consoles such as Adminer to immediately inspect student data.
        """
        with get_db_cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("SELECT student_id, name, cgpa FROM students ORDER BY student_id ASC;")
            rows = cur.fetchall()
            self.assertGreater(len(rows), 0)
            first_student = dict(rows[0])
            self.assertIn("student_id", first_student)
            self.assertIn("name", first_student)
            self.assertIn("cgpa", first_student)

    def test_admin_grade_edit_updates_students_view_and_plan(self):
        """
        Critical Requirement:
        Verify that an admin grade edit updates the student record (visible in Adminer/students view)
        and automatically triggers plan re-synthesis with a new version number.
        """
        student_id = "BH-SW-001"
        profile_before = StudentStore.get_profile(student_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(profile_before)
        initial_cgpa = profile_before.cgpa

        # Perform admin grade edit
        req = EditGradeRequest(
            student_id=student_id,
            course_code="CSL100",
            new_grade="A"
        )
        res = edit_student_grade(req)
        self.assertEqual(res["status"], "success")
        self.assertEqual(res["student_id"], student_id)
        self.assertEqual(res["updated_course"], "CSL100")
        self.assertEqual(res["new_grade"], "A")
        self.assertIn("new_plan_version", res)

        # Verify update in student_profiles store
        profile_after = StudentStore.get_profile(student_id)
        self.assertEqual(profile_after.cgpa, res["recomputed_cgpa"])

        # Verify update appears immediately in the 'students' view (which Adminer reads)
        with get_db_cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("SELECT cgpa, completed_courses_json FROM students WHERE student_id = ?;", (student_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            self.assertIsNotNone(row)
            row_dict = dict(row)
            self.assertEqual(row_dict["cgpa"], res["recomputed_cgpa"])
            self.assertIn('"grade": "A"', row_dict["completed_courses_json"])

    def test_make_reset_restores_clean_seeds(self):
        """Verifies that reset_database + load_seed_data restores a clean state."""
        counts = load_seed_data(reset=True)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(counts.get("courses", 0), 20)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(counts.get("modules", 0), 100)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(counts.get("skills", 0), 20)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(counts.get("exercises", 0), 100)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""
Tests for Infeasible Request Handling (§2.3).
Verifies that mathematically or regulatorily impossible requests:
1. Clearly say 'not possible'.
2. Name the exact blocking constraint / rule.
3. Offer a valid alternative plan or sequential bridge.
"""

import pytest
from backend.planner.infeasible import infeasible_handler
from backend.student.model import StudentStore, StudentProfile, CompletedCourse
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def setup_students():
    load_seed_data(reset=True)
    # Ensure synthetic low-CGPA students exist
    StudentStore.save_profile(StudentProfile(
        student_id="BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-1",
        name="Test Ineligible Minor Student 1",
        programme="BH-CSE-BTECH",
        year=2,
        current_semester=3,
        cgpa=6.2,
        goal_id="goal_software",
        completed_courses=[CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL100", grade="B", semester=1, credits=4.5)],
        available_hours_per_week=15.0
    ))
    StudentStore.save_profile(StudentProfile(
        student_id="BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-2",
        name="Test Ineligible Minor Student 2",
        programme="BH-CSE-BTECH",
        year=2,
        current_semester=3,
        cgpa=5.8,
        goal_id="goal_higher_studies",
        completed_courses=[CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL100", grade="C", semester=1, credits=4.5)],
        available_hours_per_week=12.0
    ))


INFEASIBLE_SCENARIOS = [
    # 1. Excessive credits (32 credits requested by BH-SW-001)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-SW-001",
        "request_type": "excessive_credits",
        "kwargs": {"credits": 32.0},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_sem_max_credits",
        "desc": "32 credits requested (exceeds semester cap)"
    },
    # 2. Excessive credits (30 credits requested by BH-HS-001)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-HS-001",
        "request_type": "excessive_credits",
        "kwargs": {"credits": 30.0},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_sem_max_credits",
        "desc": "30 credits requested (exceeds semester cap)"
    },
    # 3. Missing prerequisite (CSL252 requires CSL100, CSL201, CSL202)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-1",
        "request_type": "missing_prerequisite",
        "kwargs": {"course_code": "CSL252"},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_prereq_strict_enforcement",
        "desc": "CSL252 requested without CSL201/CSL202 prerequisites"
    },
    # 4. Missing prerequisite (CSL510 requires CSL252)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-2",
        "request_type": "missing_prerequisite",
        "kwargs": {"course_code": "CSL510"},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_prereq_strict_enforcement",
        "desc": "CSL510 requested without CSL252 prerequisite"
    },
    # 5. Ineligible CS minor (CGPA 6.2 < 7.0 cutoff)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-1",
        "request_type": "ineligible_minor",
        "kwargs": {"discipline": "Computer Science"},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_minor_cse_eligibility",
        "desc": "CS minor requested with CGPA 6.2 (< 7.0)"
    },
    # 6. Ineligible CS minor (CGPA 5.8 < 7.0 cutoff)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-2",
        "request_type": "ineligible_minor",
        "kwargs": {"discipline": "Computer Science"},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_minor_cse_eligibility",
        "desc": "CS minor requested with CGPA 5.8 (< 7.0)"
    },
    # 7. Semester parity mismatch (Spring course CSL252 in Autumn Semester 5)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-SW-001",
        "request_type": "semester_parity",
        "kwargs": {"course_code": "CSL252", "target_semester": 5},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_semester_parity",
        "desc": "Even-semester course requested in odd semester"
    },
    # 8. Semester parity mismatch (Autumn course CSL304 in Spring Semester 6)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-SW-001",
        "request_type": "semester_parity",
        "kwargs": {"course_code": "CSL304", "target_semester": 6},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_semester_parity",
        "desc": "Odd-semester course requested in even semester"
    },
    # 9. Disallowed overload (CGPA 6.2 requesting 26 credits)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-TEST-LOWCGPA-1",
        "request_type": "disallowed_overload",
        "kwargs": {"credits": 26.0},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_credit_overload_cap",
        "desc": "Credit overload requested with CGPA below 8.0"
    },
    # 10. Credit underload (6 credits requested, floor is 12)
    {
        "student_id": "BH-SW-001",
        "request_type": "credit_underload",
        "kwargs": {"credits": 6.0},
        "expected_rule_id": "rule_sem_min_credits",
        "desc": "6 credits requested (below 12 credit floor)"
    }
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("scenario", INFEASIBLE_SCENARIOS, ids=[s["desc"] for s in INFEASIBLE_SCENARIOS])
def test_infeasible_request_detection_and_resolution(scenario):
    student_id = scenario["student_id"]
    req_type = scenario["request_type"]
    kwargs = scenario["kwargs"]
    expected_rule = scenario["expected_rule_id"]

    res = infeasible_handler.evaluate_request(student_id, req_type, **kwargs)

    # 1. System must return status infeasible
    assert res["status"] == "infeasible", f"Expected infeasible status for: {scenario['desc']}"

    # 2. System must explicitly say 'not possible'
    verdict = res.get("verdict", "").lower()
    explanation = res.get("explanation", "").lower()
    assert (verdict == "not possible" or "not possible" in explanation), (
        f"Response did not clearly state 'not possible': {res.get('explanation')}"
    )

    # 3. System must name the violated constraint / blocking rule
    blocking = res.get("blocking_rule", {})
    assert blocking.get("rule_id") == expected_rule, (
        f"Expected blocking rule {expected_rule}, got {blocking.get('rule_id')}"
    )
    assert blocking.get("rule_name"), "Blocking rule must have a human-readable name"

    # 4. System must offer a valid alternative
    alt = res.get("valid_alternative") or res.get("closest_valid_plan")
    assert alt is not None, f"System failed to provide a valid alternative for: {scenario['desc']}"
    if isinstance(alt, dict) and "summary" in alt:
        assert len(alt["summary"]) > 10, "Alternative summary must be descriptive"

import unittest
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.api.courses import list_courses, get_course_detail, list_skills, list_academic_rules, list_goal_templates, list_programmes

"""
Automated tests for LiteLLM wrapper, offline fallback, caching, and safety guardrails.
"""

import unittest
import json
from backend.llm.client import llm_client, call_logger
from backend.llm.cache import llm_cache

class TestLLMWrapper(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        llm_cache.clear()

    def test_offline_fallback_goal_intake(self):
        # Even with no LLM key, goal intake returns structured valid JSON
        from unittest.mock import patch
        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "I want to become a software engineer at a top tech company"}]
        with patch.object(llm_client, "is_live", return_value=False):
            res = llm_client.generate(call_type="GOAL_INTAKE", messages=messages)
            self.assertTrue(res["fallback_used"])
            self.assertIn("content", res)
            
            parsed = json.loads(res["content"])
            self.assertEqual(parsed["goal_id"], "goal_software")
            self.assertEqual(parsed["target_role"], "Software Development Engineer")

    def test_offline_fallback_explain_plan(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        mock_plan = [
            {"semester": 3, "code": "CSL202", "title": "Data Structures", "credits": 4, "skills_targeted": ["Data Structures", "Algorithms"]},
            {"semester": 3, "code": "EEL101", "title": "Basic Electronics Engineering", "credits": 4, "skills_targeted": []}
        ]
        with patch.object(llm_client, "is_live", return_value=False):
            res = llm_client.generate(
                call_type="EXPLAIN_PLAN",
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain my schedule"}],
                fallback_data={"plan_items": mock_plan, "student_name": "Aarav"}
            )
            self.assertTrue(res["fallback_used"])
            self.assertIn("CSL202", res["content"])
            self.assertIn("Semester 3", res["content"])

    def test_caching_layer(self):
        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "What is Bayesian Knowledge Tracing?"}]
        res1 = llm_client.generate(call_type="BUDDY_CHAT", messages=messages)
        
        # Second call with same message must hit cache
        res2 = llm_client.generate(call_type="BUDDY_CHAT", messages=messages)
        self.assertEqual(res1["content"], res2["content"])
        
        stats = llm_cache.stats()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(stats["cache_hits"], 1)

    def test_course_code_hallucination_filter(self):
        valid_courses = ["CSL202", "CSL252", "MAL403"]
        test_text = "You should take CSL202 and FAK999 for machine learning."
        verified = llm_client._verify_course_codes(test_text, valid_courses)
        self.assertIn("CSL202", verified)
        self.assertIn("FAK999 (Note: Unverified course code)", verified)

    def test_security_unset_model_and_token(self):
        import os
        import importlib
        import backend.config
        old_model = os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL")
        old_token = os.environ.get("ADMIN_API_TOKEN")
        try:
            os.environ["LLM_MODEL"] = ""
            os.environ["ADMIN_API_TOKEN"] = ""
            importlib.reload(backend.config)
            cfg = backend.config.settings
            self.assertTrue(cfg.OFFLINE_MODE)
            self.assertIsNone(cfg.LLM_MODEL)
            self.assertTrue(len(cfg.ADMIN_API_TOKEN) >= 32)
        finally:
            if old_model is not None:
                os.environ["LLM_MODEL"] = old_model
            else:
                os.environ.pop("LLM_MODEL", None)
            if old_token is not None:
                os.environ["ADMIN_API_TOKEN"] = old_token
            else:
                os.environ.pop("ADMIN_API_TOKEN", None)
            importlib.reload(backend.config)

    def test_telemetry_logging(self):
        summary = call_logger.get_summary()
        self.assertIn("total_calls", summary)
        self.assertIn("p50_latency_ms", summary)
        self.assertGreater(summary["total_calls"], 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""
Integration Test for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Session Persistence (§2.5).
Verifies that:
1. Student profile attributes (goal, CGPA, completed courses) persist.
2. Multi-turn Buddy conversations are stored in DB and survive session restart.
3. Plan version history (baseline and adapted plans with diffs) persists.
4. Buddy memory synthesis ('What I remember about you') retains past decisions.
5. Operates across SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.
"""

import os
import json
import pytest
from pathlib import Path

from backend.db.database import get_db_cursor, is_postgres
from backend.db.seed_loader import load_seed_data
from backend.student.model import StudentStore, StudentProfile, CompletedCourse
from backend.buddy.memory import buddy_memory
from backend.buddy.router import buddy_router
from backend.planner.solver import multi_semester_planner
from backend.planner.validator import independent_validator
from backend.llm.client import llm_client


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def setup_environment():
    load_seed_data(reset=True)
    # Ensure offline mode for fast, deterministic LLM calls during tests
    llm_client.offline = True


def test_long_term_memory_and_session_restart():
    test_student_id = "BH-TEST-MEM-001"

    # Step 1: Create student profile with explicit career goal
    profile = StudentProfile(
        student_id=test_student_id,
        name="Ananya Sharma",
        programme="BH-CSE-BTECH",
        year=3,
        current_semester=5,
        cgpa=8.45,
        goal_id="goal_software",
        target_role="Full Stack & Systems Engineer",
        available_hours_per_week=16.0,
        completed_courses=[
            CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL100", grade="A", semester=1, credits=4.5),
            CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL201", grade="A-", semester=3, credits=4.0),
            CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL202", grade="B", semester=3, credits=4.0),
            CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL251", grade="A", semester=4, credits=4.0),
            CompletedCourse(course_code="CSL252", grade="B+", semester=4, credits=4.0),
        ]
    )
    StudentStore.save_profile(profile)

    # Step 2: Generate baseline plan (Version 1) and record in DB
    plan_v1 = multi_semester_planner.plan_curriculum(
        student_id=test_student_id,
        programme_code=profile.programme,
        current_semester=profile.current_semester,
        cgpa=profile.cgpa,
        completed_courses=[c.course_code for c in profile.completed_courses],
        skill_gaps=[],
        goal_id=profile.goal_id,
        credit_cap=22.0
    )
    val_v1 = independent_validator.validate_plan(plan_v1, profile.model_dump())
    assert val_v1["is_valid"], f"Baseline plan validation failed: {val_v1.get('errors')}"

    with get_db_cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
            INSERT INTO plan_versions (student_id, version_number, plan_json, diff_from_previous_json, validation_report_json)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            test_student_id,
            1,
            json.dumps(plan_v1),
            None,
            json.dumps(val_v1)
        ))

    # Step 3: Hold multi-turn Buddy conversation
    # Turn 1: Goal inquiry
    turn1 = buddy_router.handle_message(
        test_student_id,
        "What are my priority skill gaps for my software engineering goal?"
    )
    assert turn1["intent"] == "SKILL_GAPS"
    assert turn1["facts_used"]

    # Turn 2: Course decision & override discussion
    turn2 = buddy_router.handle_message(
        test_student_id,
        "I don't want to take CSL301 next semester, what are the trade-offs?"
    )
    assert turn2["intent"] == "OVERRIDE_COURSE"

    # Turn 3: Plan adaptation (Version 2) with recorded diff
    plan_v2 = dict(plan_v1)
    plan_v2["version"] = 2
    plan_diff = {
        "reason": "Student requested course override for CSL301; deferred to semester 7",
        "courses_added": ["CSL304"],
        "courses_removed": ["CSL301"],
        "credit_delta": 0.0
    }
    with get_db_cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
            INSERT INTO plan_versions (student_id, version_number, plan_json, diff_from_previous_json, validation_report_json)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            test_student_id,
            2,
            json.dumps(plan_v2),
            json.dumps(plan_diff),
            json.dumps(val_v1)
        ))

    # Turn 4: Asking why the plan changed
    turn4 = buddy_router.handle_message(
        test_student_id,
        "Why did my plan change?"
    )
    assert turn4["intent"] == "PLAN_DIFF"

    # Step 4: Simulate Application / Session Restart
    # By querying purely from clean DB cursors, bypassing any in-memory references
    persisted_profile = StudentStore.get_profile(test_student_id)
    assert persisted_profile is not None
    assert persisted_profile.name == "Ananya Sharma"
    assert persisted_profile.goal_id == "goal_software"
    assert persisted_profile.cgpa == 8.45
    assert len(persisted_profile.completed_courses) == 5

    # Step 5: Verify Plan Version History cross-session
    with get_db_cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
            SELECT version_number, plan_json, diff_from_previous_json
            FROM plan_versions
            WHERE student_id = ?
            ORDER BY version_number ASC
        """, (test_student_id,))
        rows = cur.fetchall()

    assert len(rows) == 2, f"Expected 2 plan versions, found {len(rows)}"
    assert rows[0]["version_number"] == 1
    assert rows[0]["diff_from_previous_json"] is None
    assert rows[1]["version_number"] == 2
    assert "deferred to semester 7" in rows[1]["diff_from_previous_json"]

    # Step 6: Verify Conversational History in chat_memory
    recent_history = buddy_memory.get_recent_history(test_student_id, limit=20)
    assert len(recent_history) >= 6, f"Expected at least 6 turns (user+assistant), got {len(recent_history)}"

    user_messages = [t["content"] for t in recent_history if t["role"] == "user"]
    assert any("priority skill gaps" in m for m in user_messages)
    assert any("trade-offs" in m for m in user_messages)
    assert any("Why did my plan change" in m for m in user_messages)

    # Step 7: Verify 'What I remember about you' memory facts synthesis
    memory_facts = buddy_memory.get_student_memory_facts(test_student_id)
    assert memory_facts["known"] is True
    assert memory_facts["student_name"] == "Ananya Sharma"
    assert memory_facts["goal"] == "goal_software"
    # Past decisions must be reflected
    facts_str = " ".join(memory_facts["facts"])
    assert "Software" in facts_str
    assert "Has explored course overrides and trade-off comparisons." in memory_facts["facts"]

    print("\n[SUCCESS] Long-term memory integration test passed:")
    print(f"  - Database engine: {'PostgreSQL' if is_postgres() else 'SQLite'}")
    print(f"  - Profile persisted: {persisted_profile.student_id} ({persisted_profile.name})")
    print(f"  - Plan versions persisted: {len(rows)} versions with diff history")
    print(f"  - Chat memory turns: {len(recent_history)} turns persisted")
    print(f"  - Memory facts synthesized: {len(memory_facts['facts'])} facts including past decisions")
